title: MasterSet: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Must-Cite Citation Recommendation in the AI/ML Literature
abstract: arXiv:2604.17680v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The explosive growth of AI and machine learning literature -- with venues like NeurIPS and ICLR now accepting thousands of papers annually -- has made comprehensive citation coverage increasingly difficult for researchers. While citation recommendation has been studied for over a decade, existing systems primarily focus on broad relevance rather than identifying the critical set of ``must-cite'' papers: direct experimental baselines, foundational methods, and core dependencies whose omission would misrepresent a contribution's novelty or undermine reproducibility. We introduce MasterSet, a large-scale benchmark specifically designed to evaluate must-cite recommendation in the AI/ML domain. MasterSet incorporates over 150,000 papers collected from official conference proceedings/websites of 15 leading venues, serving as a comprehensive candidate pool for retrieval. translated_title: MasterSet：AI/ML文献中必须引用推荐的大规模基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.17680v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：人工智能和机器学习文献的爆炸性增长——像NeurIPS和ICLR这样的会议现在每年接受数千篇论文——使得研究人员越来越难以实现全面的引文覆盖。尽管引文推荐已被研究了十多年，现有系统主要关注广泛的相关性，而非识别关键的“必须引用”论文集合：直接实验基线、基础方法和核心依赖，这些缺失会歪曲贡献的新颖性或破坏可重复性。我们引入了MasterSet，一个专门设计用于评估AI/ML领域必须引用推荐的大规模基准。MasterSet包含了从15个领先会议的官方会议录/网站收集的超过15万篇论文，作为检索的全面候选池。我们用一个三层标注方案对引文进行注释：（I）实验[性基线]
tldr: 本文提出了MasterSet，一个包含15万篇论文的大规模基准，用于评估AI/ML文献中“必须引用”推荐，通过三层标注方案（实验基线、基础方法和核心依赖）来提升引文覆盖的准确性和可重复性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MasterSet, a large-scale benchmark with over 150,000 papers for evaluating must-cite recommendation in AI/ML literature, using a three-tier labeling scheme (experimental baselines, foundational methods, and core dependencies) to improve citation coverage and reproducibility.
